l1_experiences.L1_1: Decompose the technical task into a small, repeatable pipeline (diagnose → locate relevant code/config → implement changes in isolated modules → apply/build/run → validate with targeted tooling), using fast diagnostic commands and search/navigation tools early to guide each step and verify progress before moving on.
l1_experiences.L1_2: Decompose technical workflows into clear, sequential phases (inspect/validate inputs → transform/aggregate → apply changes → test outputs), and at each phase proactively verify data structure/schema and accessibility, using robust tooling (e.g., `awk` associative arrays or specialized utilities) while logging intermediate results to catch errors early and ensure traceability.
l1_experiences.L1_3: Proactively establish a clean, well-understood execution context (detect environment/OS, enforce deterministic resource naming, and clean up prior artifacts) and then execute the workflow in modular stages with explicit, domain-appropriate modeling and verification at each step to prevent conflicts and catch errors early.
l1_experiences.L1_4: Perform pre-flight validation and incremental verification: before making changes, inspect the current environment/resources (files, permissions, running services) and proactively resolve conflicts, then execute the task in phases with automated, scriptable checks after each step to catch errors and constraint violations early.
l1_experiences.L1_5: Checkpointed staged execution: First validate prerequisites and inspect inputs, then decompose the task into clear, staged steps with saved checkpoints and fallback paths with timeouts to ensure forward progress when operations fail.
l1_experiences.L1_6: Decompose the workflow into small, verifiable phases and run pre-flight checks for environment state and dependencies (including cleanup/idempotent resource handling) before executing each phase, so failures are isolated early and you can recover via deterministic cleanup or fallback execution paths instead of letting a single blocked dependency derail the whole task.
l1_experiences.L1_7: Preflight dependency validation: Validate all external dependencies (containers, packages, environment variables, services, connectivity) before execution, and embed fallback/cleanup logic to handle conflicts or transient errors, then proceed in small, testable stages.
l1_experiences.L1_8: Resilient modular workflow: Adopt a modular, dependency-conscious workflow that breaks tasks into independent stages, pre-validates resources, defaults to lightweight local tools or parallel processing, and isolates dependencies to maintain progress despite unreliable services, with clear logging for debuggability.
l1_experiences.L1_9: Robust scripting with logging and fallbacks: Map inputs, cache repeated observations, use isolated environments and modular design with logging for observability, apply systematic fallback checks, and verify outputs against requirements rather than trusting exit codes.
l1_experiences.L1_10: Verification-first iteration loop: Prototype locally, inspect inputs, and automate while logging metrics and assertions, using measurable outcomes to iteratively refine until specifications are met.
l1_experiences.L1_11: Minimal end-to-end slice: Start with a minimal viable end-to-end slice to validate tooling, data, and expected outputs early, then scale incrementally while hardening input boundaries and verifying intermediate results against explicit assertions.
l1_experiences.L1_12: Tiered validation workflow: Before processing, audit the environment and constraints; execute with minimal, robust tools first, escalating to heavier methods only as needed, while continuously inspecting outputs to ensure correctness.
l1_experiences.L1_13: Primary-source ground-truth anchoring: After generating structured outputs from raw data, extract ground truth by scanning raw input structure, reverse-engineering internal parameters, or exhaustively logging candidate extremes, then cross-check critical values against this independent baseline to catch semantic errors and systematic processing flaws that format validators miss.
l1_experiences.L1_14: Checklist-based artifact integrity: When generating outputs with interdependent parts (graphs, spreadsheets, parsed data), apply a programmed checklist of cross-component integrity checks (connectivity, field alignment, formula accuracy) and repair failures before finalizing.

l2_experiences.L2_0: Systematic decomposition and verification: Transform ambiguous tasks into a linear, gated sequence of small, independently testable stages bounded by preconditions and verifiable outputs. Embed tiered validation: begin with lightweight environment/structural checks, then cross-verify critical outputs against authoritative ground truth. Initiate with a minimal end-to-end slice to validate assumptions, then expand iteratively with verification. Use automated checks, explicit fallback plans, and recovery strategies to isolate failures, ensuring controlled incremental progress and auditable execution across domains.
